answer_1.quote: ToolBH systematically assesses hallucinations from perspectives of depth and breadth... In the assessment of hallucination depth, we introduce a multi-level diagnostic procedure framework that incorporates (1) solvability detection, (2) solution planning, and (3) missing-tool analysis.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs include binary solvability decisions, sequences of tools for task planning, and descriptions of missing tools' functionalities.

answer_2.quote: we establish an evaluation metric for each diagnostic task... For solvability detection, we utilize the exact match (EM) as the metric... For solution planning, we design a new progress rate (PR) metric... For missing-tool analysis, we include two metrics: progress rate (PR) and matching score (MS).
